verdict.rationale: LegalZoom sells registered-agent service online at a published price ($249/year, auto-renewing) and lists its own address as the registered agent on public records. For an agent change, it says it will file the paperwork and update the Secretary of State itself, which covers the change-filing half of the story. Nothing shows the founder receives the exact agent name and street address at purchase, or the same day, to put on their own formation filing. missing for 10: documented immediate/same-day delivery of the agent name and street address after purchase, per-state address disclosure for formation filings, independent or hands-on corroboration of the online purchase-to-address flow.
